Man Booked by CBI for Posing as PMO Official at AIIMS

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has registered a case against a man from Delhi for allegedly impersonating a Prime Minister's Office (PMO) official. The accused reportedly sought preferential treatment at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS). The CBI booked the individual based on these allegations.
